independence_note: The labeled pool was authored by the same agent that maintains the reranker. It is a pre-registered, frozen evaluation set for dev measurement and regression detection, NOT independent validation. Label definitions are stated below and applied per record; a separately authored set is required before any generalization claim.

label_definitions.failure: the record explicitly addresses the problem's failure mode or device failure (1) or does not (0)
label_definitions.causal: the record states a causal relation (cause/lead to/mechanism/because/results from) about a device-failure-relevant system (1) or not (0)
label_definitions.boundary: the record states an operating boundary condition (flow/pressure/temperature/load/speed/sampling interval) relevant to the problem (1) or not (0)
label_definitions.evidence: the record reports a measured or quantitatively observed effect (1) or not (0)
label_definitions.transfer: the record describes an intervention or mechanism that could transfer to the problem's device class and shares at least two problem-fact terms (1) or not (0)

problem.failure: thrombotic occlusion of the catheter lumen under low flow
problem.constraint: maintain drainage above 0.05 mL/min at venous pressure

records.title: Heparin-bonded catheter lumens reduce thrombus formation under low flow
records.abstract: In a bench study, heparin bonding of the catheter lumen inhibited clotting cascade activation at the luminal surface. At a flow rate of 50 mL/min, thrombus area was reduced by 50 percent versus untreated polyurethane controls, and drainage remained above 0.05 mL/min.

records.title: Mechanical aspiration clears catheter lumen thrombus
records.abstract: Aspiration removed organized thrombus from occluded dialysis catheter lumens. The mechanism is mechanical extraction of the clot; flow rate recovered above 0.05 mL/min in 8 of 10 cases. Bench testing measured a 60 percent reduction in thrombus burden.

records.title: Surface roughness promotes fibrin deposition in central venous catheters
records.abstract: Rough luminal surfaces cause fibrin deposition because platelets adhere to microdefects. Under low flow, stasis accelerates clotting; smoother surfaces reduced deposit thickness by 35 percent.

records.title: Low-flow stasis leads to fibrin sleeve formation
records.abstract: Venous stasis results in fibrin sleeve formation around catheter tips. The mechanism is flow-dependent: below 0.05 mL/min, clotting cascade activation outpaces fibrinolysis. Pressure and flow boundary conditions determine occlusion risk.

records.title: Complications of tunneled hemodialysis catheters: a review
records.abstract: This review summarizes infectious and thrombotic complications of tunneled catheters, including occlusion and thrombosis.

records.title: Heparin pharmacokinetics after intravenous bolus
records.abstract: Heparin clearance follows saturable kinetics; anticoagulant effect depends on plasma concentration.

records.title: Interlaminar stress in composite beams
records.abstract: The governing role of interlaminar stress in determining structural performance and failure; fatigue crack growth, delamination, stress distribution, fracture, load transfer, stiffness degradation.

records.title: Thermal runaway in lithium battery separators
records.abstract: Separator shutdown causes thermal runaway; temperature and pressure boundary conditions drive cell failure.

records.title: Catheter materials and biocompatibility review
records.abstract: Silicone and polyurethane catheters differ in surface energy, radiopacity, and biocompatibility; catheter lumen surface treatment also affects stiffness and kink resistance.

records.title: Central venous pressure monitoring practice
records.abstract: Central venous pressure is monitored through the catheter lumen; transducer level and waveform interpretation affect reading accuracy.

problem.device: rolling-element bearing in a 350 kW industrial fan drive
problem.failure: inner-race spalling progresses for weeks before the vibration alarm trips
problem.constraint: predictor must use the existing 1 kHz vibration sensor

records.title: Vibration envelope analysis detects inner-race bearing spalling
records.abstract: Envelope demodulation of the 1 kHz vibration sensor signal detects inner-race spalling weeks before the alarm trips. The mechanism is impact excitation at the spall edge; measured detection lead time was 21 days.

records.title: Acoustic emission tracks subsurface crack growth in rolling bearings
records.abstract: Acoustic emission correlates with subsurface crack growth because crack faces rub under load. Bearing spalling onset was detected at 1 kHz sampling; measured emission energy rose 3-fold before visible damage.

records.title: Lubricant film breakdown leads to asperity contact and spalling
records.abstract: Oil film collapse causes asperity contact, which initiates fatigue cracks and spalling on the inner race. At 3000 rpm and high load, film thickness fell below 0.1 micron.

records.title: Speed-dependent resonance amplifies spall impacts
records.abstract: Inner-race spall impacts excite a resonance whose amplitude increases with shaft speed. The mechanism explains why vibration alarm thresholds fail under variable speed; measured amplitude doubled at 1800 rpm.

records.title: Bearing load ratings and fatigue life catalog
records.abstract: Catalog load ratings predict bearing fatigue life but do not describe spalling progression.

records.title: Interlaminar stress in composite beams
records.abstract: The governing role of interlaminar stress in determining structural performance and failure; fatigue crack growth, delamination, stress distribution, fracture, load transfer, stiffness degradation.

records.title: Gearbox tooth root crack detection using vibration
records.abstract: Vibration monitoring detects gear tooth root cracks; the mechanism is mesh stiffness variation.

records.title: Wind turbine blade erosion under rain impact
records.abstract: Rain droplet impact causes leading-edge erosion; coating hardness and impact speed control material loss.

records.title: Rolling-element bearing geometry and tolerance standards
records.abstract: This standard defines rolling-element bearing dimensions, internal clearance, tolerances, and mounting practice for industrial fan drives.

records.title: Vibration sensor mounting for industrial machinery
records.abstract: Accelerometer mounting stiffness and cable routing affect the measured vibration spectrum on industrial fan drives.

problem.device: 12 V lead-acid battery in a parked vehicle
problem.failure: quiescent current drain flattens the battery after 12 hours parked
problem.constraint: sleep current must stay below 10 mA without disabling wake

records.title: Sleep-state scheduler reduces quiescent current in parked vehicles
records.abstract: A sleep-state scheduler gates idle modules and reduces parasitic load. Measured quiescent current fell below 10 mA after 12 hours parked while wake latency stayed under 50 ms.

records.title: Relay isolation disconnects parasitic load circuits
records.abstract: A relay isolates the offending circuit because standby modules draw current even when the vehicle is parked. Bench measurement showed quiescent drain dropped from 45 mA to 8 mA.

records.title: Dark current measurement identifies the parasitic drain offender
records.abstract: Fuse-by-fuse current measurement locates the module causing quiescent drain. The method measures voltage drop across fuses; a 12-hour parked test identified the offender.

records.title: Low-power wake controller cuts standby draw
records.abstract: A wake controller with a low-power comparator reduces standby current; the mechanism is duty-cycled sensing. Quiescent current measured 6 mA, below the 10 mA constraint.

records.title: Lead-acid battery self-discharge and sulfation review
records.abstract: Self-discharge and sulfation degrade lead-acid batteries during long storage.

records.title: Thermal derating of inverter modules under overload
records.abstract: Thermal derating limits junction temperature under overload; the mechanism is temperature-dependent current limiting.

records.title: CAN bus transceiver standby current and wake behavior
records.abstract: CAN transceivers draw standby current and wake on bus activity; the mechanism is a low-power receiver. Parked vehicles measured 4 mA standby current.

records.title: Maximum power point tracking for solar panels
records.abstract: Maximum power point tracking adjusts converter duty cycle; the mechanism is impedance matching.

records.title: 12 V vehicle electrical system architecture review
records.abstract: The 12 V battery distribution architecture feeds body, chassis, and infotainment domains; fuse and harness topology determine service access in the vehicle.

records.title: Lead-acid battery charging profile and alternator voltage
records.abstract: Alternator voltage regulation and temperature compensation set the lead-acid battery charging profile; battery state of charge is estimated from open-circuit voltage.

problem.failure: chloride ingress initiates rebar corrosion and spalling
problem.constraint: inspection interval 24 months; no full deck replacement

records.title: Impressed current cathodic protection suppresses rebar corrosion
records.abstract: An impressed current system suppresses steel corrosion because the rebar is polarized cathodically. Current density was measured at 20 mA/m2; corrosion rate fell below 1 micron per year.

records.title: Epoxy barrier coating excludes chloride moisture
records.abstract: Epoxy coating forms a barrier that excludes moisture and chloride ions; diffusion through the coating controls initiation. Coating thickness of 300 microns reduced chloride ingress by 80 percent.

records.title: Chloride diffusion model predicts corrosion initiation
records.abstract: A diffusion model predicts when chloride concentration at the rebar reaches the threshold for corrosion initiation. The mechanism is Fickian transport; measured profiles matched the model at 24 months.

records.title: Corrosion potential mapping locates active zones
records.abstract: Half-cell potential mapping locates active corrosion zones because potential shifts indicate anodic activity. Survey spacing was 0.5 m and the 24-month inspection found two active zones.

records.title: Concrete mix design for bridge decks: a review
records.abstract: Mix design, water-cement ratio, and curing affect concrete durability and chloride ingress.

records.title: Bearing lubrication and film thickness
records.abstract: Oil viscosity maintains a hydrodynamic film between bearing surfaces; the mechanism is viscous shear.

records.title: Cathodic protection of buried pipelines
records.abstract: Impressed current cathodic protection suppresses external corrosion of buried steel pipelines; current density and soil resistivity control protection.

records.title: Thermal imaging of electrical panels
records.abstract: Infrared thermography detects loose connections because resistance heating raises terminal temperature.

records.title: Bridge deck inspection manual
records.abstract: Routine inspection of bridge decks records cracking, delamination, and drainage condition at a 24-month interval; inspectors classify severity by visual rating.

records.title: Reinforced concrete construction practice
records.abstract: Reinforced concrete deck construction controls cover depth, curing, and concrete placement; quality records are retained for the owner.

problem.failure: winding hotspot develops during cyclic overload and degrades insulation
problem.constraint: sampling interval 5 minutes on existing sensors

records.title: Thermal model predicts transformer winding hotspot from load history
records.abstract: A thermal model predicts hotspot temperature from load history because winding losses heat the insulation. At a 5-minute sampling interval, predicted hotspot led failure by 48 hours.

records.title: Dissolved gas analysis detects transformer arc discharge
records.abstract: Dissolved gas rate thresholds detect arc discharge because fault gases form during arcing. The monitor samples at 5-minute intervals and flagged discharge within one interval.

records.title: Fiber optic sensors measure winding hotspot temperature
records.abstract: Fiber Bragg sensors measure winding hotspot temperature directly; the mechanism is temperature-dependent refractive index shift. Measured hotspot was 120 C at overload.

records.title: Loading guide calculates insulation aging under cyclic overload
records.abstract: The loading guide calculates insulation aging from winding temperature because thermal stress degrades paper insulation. Cyclic overload at 5-minute sampling predicted a 2-fold aging rate.

records.title: Transformer oil testing schedule: a review
records.abstract: Oil testing schedules cover dielectric strength, moisture, and dissolved gas analysis.

records.title: Lithium battery thermal runaway propagation
records.abstract: Cell-to-cell thermal runaway propagation is driven by heat transfer through the module.

records.title: Motor stator winding thermal model
records.abstract: A thermal model predicts stator winding temperature from current; the mechanism is copper loss.

records.title: Pipeline corrosion monitoring with coupons
records.abstract: Corrosion coupons measure metal loss; the mechanism is electrochemical oxidation.

records.title: Power transformer nameplate and oil volume data
records.abstract: The nameplate lists power rating, voltage ratio, impedance, and oil volume; oil volume is needed for dissolved-gas sampling calculations.

records.title: Substation sensor network installation
records.abstract: Current and temperature sensors are installed on substation equipment; sampling interval and transducer calibration are recorded in the commissioning file.
